title: Dragging on empty canvas selects every node in the box
body:
Selection in acre-gui holds one node (`selection.rs`, 12eb9d6), and a drag on empty canvas pans.

## Proposal

- The selection holds any number of nodes, each by tree path.
- A drag on empty canvas draws a box and selects every top-level drawn node whose objects lie inside it. Panning moves to a middle-button drag, which already pans.
- A click selects one node; a click on empty canvas clears.
- Dragging any selected node moves all of them, as one set of edits, with snapping on their joint box.
